mapper.insert: insert into visitor_entry(entry_id, application_id, operator_id, operator_name, create_time) values (#{entryId}, #{applicationId}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{createTime})
mapper.select:
select ve.entry_id, ve.application_id, ve.operator_name, ve.create_time as entry_time, v.name as visitor_name, v.company as visitor_company, v.phone as visitor_phone, v.id_card as visitor_id_card, v.plate_no, va.host_name, va.start_time, va.end_time from visitor_entry ve left join visitor_application va on ve.application_id = va.application_id left join visitor v on va.visitor_id = v.visitor_id where 1 = 1
and ( v.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or v.phone like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ve.operator_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
and ve.create_time >= #{beginTime}
and ve.create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
order by ve.create_time desc
